```{=typst}
// ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Section toggles — set to false to turn a section off entirely.
// ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
#let include-publications = true

// Summary — appears under the header band, above the two-column body.
// Use pystatr-blue / pystatr-gold bold spans sparingly for emphasis.
#summary-block[
  Two to four sentences summarizing your value. Highlight
  #text(weight: "bold", fill: pystatr-blue)[key programs or domains]
  and one signature recognition like a
  #text(weight: "bold", fill: pystatr-gold)[major award].
]

#two-col(
  // --- MAIN COLUMN ---
  [
    #section-title[Professional Experience]

    #entry(
      "Role Title",
      "Organization",
      "City, ST",
      "2022 — Present",
      (
        [First bullet — lead with the verb and the outcome; bold the #text(weight: "bold")[programs and systems] you owned.],
        [Second bullet — quantify where you can: #text(weight: "bold", fill: pystatr-gold)[80% faster], 75+ sites, etc.],
      )
    )

    #entry(
      "Earlier Role",
      "Organization",
      "City, ST",
      "2018 — 2022",
      (
        [What you built, ran, or improved.],
      )
    )

    // Rendered only when include-publications is true (see toggle at top).
    #if include-publications [
      #section-title[Research & Publications]

      #pub-entry(
        "Title of the Paper or Article",
        "Lastname, F., Co-Author, A.",
        "Journal, Conference, or Publisher",
        "2026",
      )

      #pub-entry(
        "An Earlier Publication",
        "Lastname, F.",
        "Venue Name",
        "2024",
        note: "optional context, award, or DOI",
      )
    ]

    #section-title[Leadership & Community]

    #entry(
      "Volunteer or Founder Role",
      "Initiative Name",
      "City, ST",
      "2024 — Present",
      (
        [Community, mentorship, or open-source contributions.],
      )
    )
  ],

  // --- SIDEBAR ---
  [
    #sidebar-title[Core Competencies]

    #v(0.1em)
    #set list(indent: 0pt, body-indent: 0.35em, marker: text(fill: pystatr-gold)[▪])
    - #text(size: 8.5pt)[Competency one]
    - #text(size: 8.5pt)[Competency two]
    - #text(size: 8.5pt)[Competency three]

    #sidebar-title[Tools]

    #v(0.1em)
    - #text(size: 8.5pt)[Tool · Tool · Tool]
    - #text(size: 8.5pt)[Tool · Tool]

    #sidebar-title[Education]

    #edu("Degree · Field", "University", "City, ST", "2009 — 2011")
    #edu("Degree · Field", "University", "City, ST", "2005 — 2008")

    #v(0.6em)

    #sidebar-title[Awards]

    #award("Award Name · Year", "Issuing organization — one-line context")
  ],
)
```
